messages:
Sofia: Heads-up for M/E close: Marketing applied $85,000 in promotional credits tied to our 'first-month-free' pricing experiment. Need direction on deferral vs immediate recognition for this amount across different commit lengths.

Ethan: My read: These are contract incentives, should be deferred and recognized over the committed term unless they were performance-based and earned immediately. Did RevOps sign off?

Priya: RevOps approved the experiment but noted credits showed on the invoice as negative line items. We didn't book revenue on invoice level. See ticket FIN-7781.

Jasper: From accounting POV we need a standard approach: prorate by contract term. For customers with 6/12/24 month commits, allocate the promo deferral proportionally. If there's an early-termination clause that accelerates recognition, handle as adjustment on termination.

Sofia: Draft JE proposal (to reverse monthly):
```
Debit 4050 - Customer Promotions (expense contra) 85,000
Credit 2200 - Deferred Revenue - Promotions 85,000
Memo: Promo experiment EX-2026-04-FMF
```
Is the debit account correct?

Ethan: Use 4052 - Promo Credits (contra-revenue) instead of expense. We want to keep it contra-rev for P&L clarity. Also include contract id and split by customer in the memo.

Priya: Note: one customer (BetaWorks) elected a 24-month ramp. We'll need to prorate their portion across 24 months. I can supply contract terms list by EOD.

rev-ops-bot: Reminder: Promo credits were applied via billing job 2026-04-02T03:12Z. Invoices updated: yes. Related ticket: FIN-7781.

Jasper: Also add a small allowance for potential churn where credits may never be earned (variable consideration). Let's set a 5% conservatism reserve for these experiment credits for now; we can adjust after 30 days.

Sofia: Good call. So final plan: 1) Post JE with contra-rev account and deferred revenue 2) Allocate by contract term (per-customer schedules) 3) Create churn reserve entry (5% of total) 4) Add experiment id to revenue schedule.

Ethan: I'll update the rev schedule template to include columns: experiment_id, contract_term_months, prorated_amount, churn_reserve.

Priya: I'll upload the contract export and a mapping file to the close folder when ready. ETA: today COB.

Sofia: Thanks team. Action owners: Sofia post JE after Jasper confirms GL accounts; Priya upload contracts; Ethan update template. Ping me if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
